author: {'email': 'gajus@gajus.com', 'name': 'Gajus Kuizinas', 'url': 'http://gajus.com'}
description: Formats data into a string table.
husky: {'hooks': {'post-commit': "npm run create-readme && git add README.md && git commit -m 'docs: generate docs' --no-verify", 'pre-commit': 'npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test'}}
name: table
scripts: {'prebuild': 'rm -fr ./src/generated && mkdirp ./src/generated', 'build': 'npm run create-validators && tsc', 'create-readme': 'gitdown ./.README/README.md --output-file ./README.md', 'create-validators': 'ajv compile --all-errors --inline-refs=false -s src/schemas/config -s src/schemas/streamConfig -r src/schemas/shared -c ajv-keywords/dist/keywords/typeof -o | js-beautify > ./src/generated/validators.js', 'lint': 'eslint ./src ./test', 'test': 'nyc mocha && nyc check-coverage --lines 95'}
